name: Bullet Dodge
description: In a marble lobby time slows and the subject bends back as slow-motion bullets curve around them.

wardrobe.man: a long black leather coat, a black shirt and black trousers
wardrobe.woman: a long black leather coat, a black shirt and black trousers
wardrobe.person: a long black leather coat, a black shirt and black trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands in the middle of a grand empty marble lobby, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}, knees slightly bent, ready. Tall marble columns on both sides, a polished floor, and cold daylight falling in from high windows behind {them}, a light haze in the air. Medium-wide shot at eye level, symmetrical, the {subject} centered, full body visible. Cinematic photography, cool green-tinted daylight, high contrast, crisp reflections. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain marble walls throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands ready in the lobby, eyes locked on a point just past the camera. Time slows to a crawl: a line of bullets flies in slow motion from behind the camera, each one trailing a clear ripple of distorted air, and the {subject} leans far back in one smooth slow arc, the coat flaring out, while the bullets curve around {their} body and pass inches from {their} face, then strike the marble columns behind {them} and burst into slow clouds of white stone chips. The camera arcs slowly around the {subject} from the front to the side. Sound: a deep slowed whooshing of each bullet, a stretched low hum of slowed time, stone cracking in slow motion. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, slow motion with real air ripples and debris, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. Time slows to a crawl: a line of bullets flies in slow motion toward the {subject}, each trailing a clear ripple of distorted air, and the {subject} leans back in one smooth slow arc while the bullets curve around {their} body and pass inches away. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a deep slowed whooshing, a stretched low hum of slowed time. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, slow motion with real air ripples, sharp detail, stable picture.
